skills.name: mirrord-chaos
skills.description: Help users chaos test their app with mirrord: inject artificial latency or connection errors into a mirrord session''s outgoing traffic via per-session chaos rules managed with the `mirrord chaos` CLI. Use when a user wants to add latency or delay to outgoing connections or a dependency (e.g. a slow database), simulate connection failures (reset, timed out, refused), test app behavior under degraded network conditions, or wire chaos rules into CI test runs. Always use this skill instead of the deprecated _experimental_.latency mirrord config option.
headings: Modify (edit the file, resend with the rule id)
skills.description_zh: 通过 mirrord chaos CLI 管理会话级规则，在出站流量中注入延迟、连接重置、超时或拒绝等故障，测试网络退化时的应用表现并接入 CI；原说明要求采用此方式替代已弃用的 _experimental_.latency 配置。

skills.name: mirrord-ci
skills.description: Help users set up mirrord in CI pipelines for testing against real Kubernetes environments. Use when users want to run end-to-end tests, integration tests, or automated tests in CI using mirrord to connect to staging/shared clusters.
headings: Key Benefits of mirrord for CI
skills.description_zh: 在 CI 中配置 mirrord，使端到端、集成或自动化测试连接真实 Kubernetes 预发布或共享集群环境。

skills.name: mirrord-config
skills.description: Helps users generate, edit, and validate mirrord.json configuration files for mirrord (MetalBear). Use when the user wants to connect their local process to a Kubernetes environment, configure features (env/fs/network), or needs feedback on an existing mirrord.json. Always ensures output JSON is valid and schema-conformant.
headings: Your code is local by default — do not "fix" this with `fs.mode`
Common patterns (verify exact keys in schema):
skills.description_zh: 生成、编辑并验证 mirrord.json，配置本地进程连接 Kubernetes 时的环境变量、文件系统与网络功能，并检查 JSON 格式及 schema 符合性。

skills.name: mirrord-db-branching
skills.description: Helps users configure mirrord.json for database branching, enabling isolated database copies for safe development and testing. Use when the user wants to set up MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, MSSQL, MongoDB, Redis, DynamoDB, ClickHouse, Google Spanner, or generic branches, configure copy modes, connection sources, schema migrations, IAM authentication, or manage database branches.
headings: Filtered clone (SQL engines: MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, MSSQL, ClickHouse, Spanner)
skills.description_zh: 配置 mirrord.json 数据库分支，为开发和测试建立隔离副本；支持 MySQL、MariaDB、PostgreSQL、MSSQL、MongoDB、Redis、DynamoDB、ClickHouse、Google Spanner 及通用分支，涵盖复制模式、连接来源、迁移、IAM 认证与分支管理。

skills.name: mirrord-kafka
skills.description: Helps DevOps engineers configure mirrord Operator's Kafka queue splitting feature end-to-end. Generates the MirrordSplitConfig and MirrordPropertyList Kubernetes CRD YAMLs (the current resources; MirrordKafkaTopicsConsumer + MirrordKafkaClientConfig are deprecated but still supported), the matching mirrord.json split_queues section with message_filter and jq_filter, and Helm value guidance. Use this skill whenever the user mentions Kafka splitting with mirrord, MirrordSplitConfig, MirrordPropertyList, MirrordKafkaClientConfig, MirrordKafkaTopicsConsumer, Kafka queue/topic splitting, configuring mirrord with Kafka, Kafka Streams splitting, MSK IAM auth, or troubleshooting Kafka splitting sessions. Also trigger on split_queues with queue_type Kafka, or connecting mirrord to a Kafka cluster. This is a Team/Enterprise feature of mirrord.
headings: Legacy CRDs (only if migrating an existing setup)
skills.description_zh: 为 mirrord Operator 配置 Kafka 队列拆分，生成 MirrordSplitConfig、MirrordPropertyList CRD、mirrord.json 的消息与 jq 过滤配置及 Helm 指引；支持排查 Kafka Streams、MSK IAM 等场景，原说明注明属于 Team/Enterprise 功能，旧 CRD 已弃用但仍支持。

skills.name: mirrord-operator
skills.description: Help users install and configure the mirrord Operator for team/enterprise environments. Use when users ask about operator setup, Helm installation, cloud API key or license configuration, air-gapped/offline licensing, enabling features (queue splitting, DB branching, preview environments, multi-cluster), internal registries, OpenShift/GKE Autopilot, RBAC, or multi-user mirrord deployments.
headings: Step 1 — Add the Helm repo and download values
skills.description_zh: 安装配置团队或企业版 mirrord Operator，处理 Helm、云 API 密钥或许可证、离线授权、内部镜像仓库、OpenShift/GKE Autopilot、RBAC，以及队列拆分、数据库分支、预览环境和多集群功能。

skills.name: mirrord-prev-env
skills.description: Help users create and manage mirrord preview environments — running a modified service as an isolated pod in a shared Kubernetes cluster, scoped by an environment key and HTTP/queue traffic filtering, so teams can validate and review changes against real traffic without affecting live services. Use when a developer wants to run "mirrord preview" ad hoc, share a preview via a link (mirrord-share-ingress), or wire preview environments into CI with the metalbear-co/mirrord-preview GitHub Action (e.g. per-PR previews, least-privilege cluster access).
headings: Start a preview: deploy <image> as a preview of the target in the config, scoped to <key>
See active preview environments and their pods
Stop a preview by its environment key
Replace a running preview after rebuilding the image (same key)
Sharing a preview via a link
Mode 2 — CI with the mirrord-preview GitHub Action
skills.description_zh: 在共享 Kubernetes 集群以隔离 pod 运行修改后的服务，通过环境键和 HTTP/队列过滤建立 mirrord 预览；支持临时运行、共享链接及 GitHub Action 的逐 PR 预览与最小权限集群访问。

skills.name: mirrord-quickstart
skills.description: Guide users from zero to their first working mirrord session. Use when a user is new to mirrord, wants to install it, or needs help running their first session connecting to a Kubernetes cluster.
headings: Run a local process with mirrord
Quick test: print remote env vars
skills.description_zh: 引导初次使用者安装 mirrord，连接 Kubernetes 集群并运行首个有效会话。

skills.name: mirrord-temporal
skills.description: Helps DevOps engineers configure mirrord Operator's Temporal task queue splitting feature end-to-end. Generates the MirrordSplitConfig and MirrordPropertyList Kubernetes CRD YAMLs, the matching mirrord.json split_queues section with message_filter and jq_filter, and Helm value guidance. Use this skill whenever the user mentions Temporal splitting with mirrord, Temporal task queue splitting, splitting a Temporal worker, configuring mirrord with Temporal or Temporal Cloud, routing Temporal workflow or activity tasks to a local worker, or troubleshooting Temporal splitting sessions. Also trigger on split_queues with queue_type Temporal, or connecting mirrord to a Temporal frontend. This is an alpha Team/Enterprise feature of mirrord.
headings: Temporal splitting enabled? (CRDs are defined when operator.temporalSplitting is on)
skills.description_zh: 配置 mirrord Operator 的 Temporal 任务队列拆分，生成 CRD、mirrord.json 消息与 jq 过滤及 Helm 指引，将工作流或活动任务路由到本地 worker 并排查会话；原说明注明为 Team/Enterprise 的 alpha 功能。

skills.name: mirrord-up
skills.description: Helps users run multiple concurrent mirrord sessions from a single mirrord-up.yaml (compose-style multi-service local debugging). Use when the user mentions mirrord up, mirrord-up.yaml, mirrord up init, debugging several related microservices together, or managing multiple mirrord sessions' lifecycle in one command.
skills.description_zh: 通过一个 mirrord-up.yaml 同时管理多个 mirrord 会话，以类似 compose 的方式联合调试关联微服务，并用单条命令管理会话生命周期。
